title: Tonic Pyramid
description: Push-up pyramid then full body strength with Bulgarian split squats and plank

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
exercises.instructions: Jump spreading arms and legs, return feet together

exercises.name: Plank to downward dog
exercises.instructions: Alternate between high plank and downward dog position

exercises.name: Hip 90/90
exercises.instructions: Seated, legs at 90 degrees, rotate from side to side

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands shoulder-width apart, body braced, lower chest to the floor

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squats
exercises.instructions: Back foot on a chair, lower the knee

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.instructions: On one forearm, body aligned, hips high

exercises.name: Inverse table rows
exercises.instructions: Under a table, pull chest toward the edge

exercises.name: Chest stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm against a wall at 90 degrees, rotate the body

exercises.name: Psoas stretch
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, drive the hip forward

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.instructions: Front leg bent in front, back leg extended, lean forward

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
